competitorWins: VesselFinder's edge is honest, budget maritime tracking: satellite AIS covering the open oceans where terrestrial receivers can't reach (90% of satellite positions under 1 hour latency), a practical $12 24-hour satellite pass for surveyors, vessel photos and particulars, and plans that undercut the big rivals. For port agents, cargo superintendents and individual surveyors who need affordable fleet watching and satellite coverage, it is the value play in ship tracking.
description: VesselFinder tracks ships worldwide via terrestrial AIS (7,000+ data sources) plus optional satellite AIS for open-ocean coverage, with vessel photos, port data, weather overlays and a distance tool. It undercuts MarineTraffic on price, but the free tier is ad-supported and limited. WorldEye is complementary for casual viewers: free live ship tracking on a 3D globe combined with flights, cameras, weather, quakes, fires and satellite imagery — no registration at all.
